heroHeadline: Day 660: Sheinbaum Dismisses CIA Ops Report as 'Fictions'; First Narco-Terrorism Indictment Under FTO Framework Unsealed
heroSubtitle: 660 days of cartel civil war — May 13–14: President Sheinbaum branded CNN's report of CIA lethal operations on Mexican soil 'fictions the size of the universe' as the CIA called the story 'false and salacious' and Security Secretary García Harfuch categorically denied any foreign covert operations. The same day (May 13), DOJ unsealed the first-ever narco-terrorism charges under the Sinaloa Cartel FTO designation against El Sagitario (Pedro Inzunza Noriega) and son Pichon in San Diego federal court. US-Mexico standoff enters Day 15 over 10 indicted Sinaloa officials with no extradition; El Mayo sentencing set for July 20; war toll ~2,425+ since Sep 9, 2024; La Mayiza ~90% territorial control; 13,300+ federal troops deployed in Sinaloa.
